title: Hoshino Ichika — Distant Yet Caring〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What a nice breeze...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The flowers are swaying like they're enjoying it too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, there you are, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't find you in the classroom, so I was wondering where you'd gone to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah! Hold it, Saki! Stop where you are!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Um, okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry for raising my voice all of a sudden.
It's just, there's a flower over there, so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right! I didn't notice it at all.
Thanks for letting me know.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I almost didn't manage to avoid it... Wait!
I stepped on a little bit of the leaves!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going to happen now?
Will this flower wither and die?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um... Ah, this shouldn't be a problem.
This species of flower is pretty tough.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Phew... What a relief.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, why am I not surprised that you know so much about flowers?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know about it because it's a common flower, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But it's not just this flower.
You also know a lot about many other flowers too, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I remember you used to teach me many things about them,

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes... I did, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yep! When I was in the hospital, or bedridden at home, you'd always come visit with flowers and then tell me many different things about them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, that sure brings back memories.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I couldn't get anything grand, so I would pick just one after looking up its symbolism.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, going to the florist was so fun. I was still in elementary school then, so the shop staff would sometimes give me a discount.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so sure it was because of your flowers that I was able to recover and get discharged!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come on, Saki... That's an exaggeration.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Actually, I've been pressing those flowers you gave me and keeping them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whenever things get tough, I'd look at those flowers and it's like all my bad feelings get sucked away, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, speaking of which, I remember you once brought a morning glory that you'd planted in school too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. And I had no idea it was unlucky to visit someone with a potted flower, which was exactly what I had brought...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can still clearly remember the shocked look on the nurse's face back then!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we also planted a morning glory flower bed in the garden at my home, along with Shiho and Hona, using the seeds from that flower, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. All of us went to your house to do that, and we also went back to check on the flowers too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! But because I didn't manage to water the flowers for about a week...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It can't be helped since you weren't feeling well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But the morning glories became all droopy because of that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You were really depressed about it, so the three of us tried our best to take care of the flowers on our own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I was so surprised to see them doing so well when I went out to the garden one day after a long time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I asked mom about it, and she told me the three of you had been taking care of them. I was so touched I broke into tears right there in the garden!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, it's a precious memory of mine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Will we be able to play together like that again someday?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know! We just have to try, right?
Maybe we should talk to Hona and Shiho after school today?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, let's try that.
